notes.title: Cosmetic Rewards + Multiplayer Text Chat!
notes.notes:
This update adds cosmetics rewards for completing the game!

standard victory -> unlock the sword cosmetic
hard mode victory -> unlock the shield cosmetic

You can unlock these cosmetics in either solo or multiplayer.

This update also adds multiplayer text chat, so now you can share tips and socialize!  If people are being too rowdy, you can also mute them via the player list.

There was also a bug present before that caused lower framerates to receive slightly less gravity, so that's been fixed and values have been adjusted to compensate.  There's also some minor changes to the spike-funnel portion of the level to (hopefully) make it a bit less tedious to escape.

notes.title: controller sensitivity, invert camera y-axis
notes.notes:
added two new toggles to the settings menu:
- use controller (switches between controller and mouse camera control)
- invert y-axis

notes.title: Stat Tracking Update
notes.notes:
Your best solo time and number of solo completions in both Standard and Hard Mode are now recorded and visible from the main menu!

This update also fixes nametags in multiplayer (I accidentally broke those with the dark mode update, woops!)

notes.title: minor dark mode fix
notes.notes: small fix to make dark mode work in the multiplayer menus

notes.title: Eraser now has Dark Mode!
notes.notes: Eraser now has a dark mode!  Use the "Dark Mode" toggle in the settings menu to try it out!
